requirements: Access to Torag the Corrupted's boss encounter and any prerequisite quests, keys, instances, or killcount listed by the linked strategy source.
Use the boss-task Slayer helm or Slayer helmet bonuses when the assignment permits it.
Bring supplies and teleports appropriate to a separate boss trip rather than a normal multi-kill Slayer location.
mechanics: Torag melees, so the shared magic setup (50% wind weakness) is the recommended kill.
Treat this as a boss-specific method: positioning, prayer swaps, phase handling, and death-risk setup should come from the linked source strategy.

methods.label: General strategy
methods.summary: Torag melees, so the shared magic setup (50% wind weakness) is the recommended kill.
recommendedFor: Players selecting this boss from the Boss meta-task
steps: Torag melees, so the shared magic setup (50% wind weakness) is the recommended kill.

methods.label: Barrows route
methods.summary: Reach Barrows and usually leave Torag until after higher-risk brothers because he is a straightforward melee target.
recommendedFor: Boss Slayer assignments that roll Torag
requiredOrKeyItems: Air spell runes or powered staff
steps: Travel with Barrows teleport, Mort'ton, Morytania legs, or fairy rings.
Clear more dangerous brothers first if prayer is limited.
Use Protect from Melee when fighting Torag directly.
Use air magic to exploit the shared elemental weakness.
notes: Torag appears late in several safe and fast Wiki rotations.
Ghommal's hilt 2 or higher removes the Barrows Prayer drain.

methods.label: Protection prayer kill
methods.summary: Use Protect from Melee and air magic for a simple Torag kill.
recommendedFor: players using one shared magic setup
steps: Turn on Protect from Melee before opening Torag's sarcophagus.
Attack with air magic or a powered staff.
Conserve prayer if supplies are low by using safespot pathing.
Continue to tunnels or chest after the kill.
risks: Torag is lower-risk than Dharok but still deals melee damage if prayer drops.
Long routes can lose prayer every 18 seconds underground.
notes: Protection prayer fully negates Torag damage when active.
All brothers have a 50% air elemental weakness.

methods.label: Tunnel safespot
methods.summary: Safespot Torag with ladder squares, corridors, or any side of the sarcophagus when conserving food and prayer.
prayers: Protect from Melee when not safespotted
steps: Use tunnel ladder squares or corridor corners to trap Torag.
In his mound room, kite around the sarcophagus; Torag can be handled from all four sides.
Attack with magic while he is path-blocked.
Reactivate Protect from Melee if the block fails.
notes: The Wiki calls out Torag as one of the brothers that can be kited on all four sarcophagus sides.
Binding spells can also hold melee brothers in place.
